## Kyoto Vegetarian Trip Plan: 5 Days, Low-Walking, JPY 120,000 Total

A relaxed Kyoto plan for 2 adults, centered on temples, vegetarian-friendly meals, and short transit hops. Costs below are estimated for 2 people and keep the total within budget by using buses/subways, one taxi segment, and a mix of casual and mid-range meals.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

| Day | Focus | Transit Suggestion | Estimated Cost (2) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Higashiyama temples + traditional lunch | Subway to Higashiyama, short taxi where needed | JPY 22,000 | Best first day for classic Kyoto scenery |
| Apr 11 | Arashiyama + river area | Hankyu/JR + short local bus | JPY 24,000 | Keep the bamboo grove early to avoid crowds |
| Apr 12 | Central Kyoto temples + market food | Subway + taxi for one segment | JPY 20,000 | Lower-walking day with indoor breaks |
| Apr 13 | Fushimi Inari light visit + sake district | JR + taxi return if tired | JPY 23,000 | Do only the lower shrine section for easier pacing |
| Apr 14 | Nishiki Market + departure-day slow pace | Subway/walkable central area | JPY 16,000 | Good final day for souvenirs and an easy lunch |

## 5-Day Kyoto Itinerary for 2 Adults

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, then visit **Kiyomizu-dera** with a taxi drop-off close to the temple area.
- Afternoon: Explore **Kodai-ji** or **Yasaka Shrine** at an easy pace; choose just one if energy is low.
- Food: Vegetarian lunch near Gion or Higashiyama; look for **tofu set meals, yuba, and soba**.
- Estimated cost: **JPY 22,000** total
  - Transit: JPY 2,000
  - Food: JPY 10,000
  - Entry fees: JPY 2,000
  - Taxi buffer: JPY 8,000

### Day 2: Arashiyama Scenic Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji**; keep the route compact and skip long side walks.
- Afternoon: Enjoy the **river area** or a short scenic ride on the **Sagano** side; choose a café break instead of extra walking.
- Food: Vegetarian lunch with **temple-style dishes, curry rice, or tofu cuisine** in Arashiyama.
- Estimated cost: **JPY 24,000** total
  - Transit: JPY 3,000
  - Food: JPY 11,000
  - Entry fees: JPY 3,000
  - Taxi/backup: JPY 7,000

### Day 3: Central Kyoto Culture Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** or **Kyoto Imperial Palace area** for a lower-walking cultural stop.
- Afternoon: Spend time at **Nishiki Market** and nearby covered shopping streets; this keeps walking light and gives food variety.
- Food: Choose a vegetarian lunch of **yuba, grilled vegetables, or vegan ramen**.
- Estimated cost: **JPY 20,000** total
  - Transit: JPY 2,000
  - Food: JPY 10,000
  - Entry fees: JPY 2,000
  - Snacks/shopping buffer: JPY 6,000

### Day 4: Fushimi and Sake District Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Visit the **lower section of Fushimi Inari** only; this gives the iconic torii experience without a full hike.
- Afternoon: Head to **Fushimi sake district** for a slower neighborhood visit, museum stop, or café break.
- Food: Vegetarian lunch near Kyoto Station or Fushimi; keep dinner simple with a **tofu or vegetable hotpot**.
- Estimated cost: **JPY 23,000** total
  - Transit: JPY 3,000
  - Food: JPY 10,000
  - Entry fees: JPY 2,000
  - Taxi buffer: JPY 8,000

### Day 5: Easy Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- Morning: Slow start, then visit **Nishiki Market** or a nearby temple if time allows.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Slow start, then visit **Nishiki Market** or a nearby temple if time allows, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Buy souvenirs, enjoy one final vegetarian meal, and head to your departure point with plenty of buffer time.
- Food: Final lunch can be **vegan curry, tofu kaiseki lunch, or soba**.
- Estimated cost: **JPY 16,000** total
  - Transit: JPY 2,000
  - Food: JPY 9,000
  - Souvenirs/snacks: JPY 5,000

## Budget Check for the Full Trip

- Total estimated spend: **JPY 105,000**
- Budget cap: **JPY 120,000**
- Remaining buffer: **JPY 15,000**

Suggested use of the buffer:
- Extra taxi rides for low-walking comfort
- One nicer vegetarian dinner
- Rainy-day café time or museum entry
- Small souvenir purchases

## Rainy-Day Backup Options

### 1) Kyoto Railway Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Best for a fully indoor day with easy movement.
- Works well if you want a break from temple walking.
- Good fit for a rainy afternoon or full-day replacement.

### 2) Kyoto International Manga Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Calm indoor option with seating and low physical effort.
- Easy to pair with central Kyoto lunch and café time.
- Good choice if you want a lighter cultural day.

### 3) Nishiki Market + Covered Shopping Arcades
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Mostly sheltered, food-focused, and easy to shorten or extend.
- Great for vegetarian snacks, souvenirs, and relaxed browsing.
- Best backup when you still want a “Kyoto feel” without weather stress.

## Transit Tips for Low Walking

- Use **subway + short taxi rides** instead of trying to walk between all temple clusters.
- Keep **one major sight per half-day** to avoid fatigue.
- Stay near **Kyoto Station, Gion, or central Kyoto** for easier food and transit access.
- If you want the easiest pace, use taxis for the steepest or most crowded temple approaches.

## Sources

- Kyoto City tourism overview: https://kyoto.travel/en
- JR West travel info: https://www.westjr.co.jp/global/en/
- Kyoto City Bus and subway info: https://www.city.kyoto.lg.jp/kotsu/page/0000019442.html
